findings.title: English file path derivation is fragile and can produce wrong or nonexistent paths
findings.body: The English counterpart path is computed with regex replaceAll on the absolute path: replaceAll("resources-community", "resources") then replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", "_en.properties"). Any directory containing an underscore or the substring 'resources-community' elsewhere in the path, or a file without a locale suffix, will be rewritten incorrectly. When the English file is missing a RuntimeException is thrown, aborting verification for the whole module rather than reporting a message.

findings.title: Keys present only in the translation are checked against an empty English value, and missing English file throws
findings.body: getEnglishValue returns "" for keys missing in English, so the sanitizer decides HTML policy from an empty string and silently accepts whatever HTML the translation contains for keys that do not exist in the source. Additionally, a missing English file is converted into a RuntimeException rather than a MojoExecutionException, so the plugin crashes with an unhelpful stack trace instead of a verification message.

findings.title: Unescaping HTML entities after sanitization can reintroduce unsafe markup in the comparison
findings.body: sanitized = unescapeHtml4(sanitized) runs after the policy sanitizer. The comparison therefore accepts values in which entities such as <script> were decoded back into raw tags in the 'sanitized' string, and the check only flags a difference when the sanitized and original differ. Since value was also unescaped in normalizeValue, a translation containing '<img onerror=...>' is unescaped to a real tag before sanitizing, so the sanitizer does see it; but the post-sanitize unescape can turn entities the sanitizer intentionally kept into tags that the policy would reject, making the verifier's pass/fail result unreliable.

findings.title: Anchor validation compares tags pairwise without checking counts or using the replaced value consistently
findings.body: santizeAnchors walks anchors in the translation and in English with two independent matchers, and removes the matched English anchor text from value via replaceFirst on the translation. If the translation has more anchors than English, englishMatcher.find() fails and the message is added, but if it has fewer, extra English anchors are never reported. Also replaceFirst with a quoted pattern removes the first occurrence in value, which may not be the anchor just matched, so the check can pass or fail based on text position rather than structure.

findings.title: Policy factories are instance fields with non-private visibility and the HTML_TAGS pattern is package-private
findings.body: POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS are declared without modifiers at package level, while sibling constants are private static. This is inconsistent and makes them mutable from the package; they should be static final to avoid rebuilding policies per instance.

findings.title: Tests rely on fixtures whose English counterparts are not present and do not cover the passing path
findings.body: The new tests call verify() on *_de.properties fixtures, but the English path derivation resolves to *_en.properties in the same directory; the tests never assert that a valid translation produces no messages, nor that a correct anchor passes. The duplicate-key test was relaxed from Matchers.contains to hasItem, weakening the assertion so extra unexpected messages go undetected.

findings.title: Fixture contains an unclosed tag that is also used as the English source
findings.body: The fixture 'key=Some <div>tag</div' is malformed (missing '>'). The test asserts an 'Illegal HTML' message, but the failure may be caused by the malformed syntax rather than the intended illegal tag, so the test does not verify what its name says.

findings.title: Translated instruction text replaces the link-bearing content with a generic sentence that drops the app names
findings.body: The totpStep1 string is changed to a generic sentence, removing the FreeOTP and Google Authenticator references and links. This is an unrelated content change to a translation file that loses information users need to set up OTP. It appears to be a side effect of the sanitizer change rather than an intended translation fix.

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with untranslated Italian text
findings.body: The new value 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' is Italian, not Lithuanian, so Lithuanian users will see a foreign-language instruction. The string should be translated or the original kept.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: Same problem as the account bundle: the value is an Italian sentence, so the Lithuanian login page shows untranslated content.

findings.title: Hungarian emailUpdateConfirmationBodyHtml key prefixed with *** corrupting the key name
findings.body: The line was changed to start with '***emailUpdateConfirmationBodyHtml=', so the property key is now '***emailUpdateConfirmationBodyHtml' and the real key is no longer translated. The HTML email body falls back to English or is missing.

findings.title: Turkish identityProviderLinkBodyHtml changed whitespace inside tags and made the anchor unbalanced
findings.body: The closing tags were changed from '' to '' and ' {1} ' spacing was altered; while '' is not valid HTML, the changes are unrelated to sanitization and break rendering of the email.

findings.title: Dutch emailVerificationBodyHtml contains a malformed closing tag
findings.body:
The line was changed from '

' ... '

U kunt' to '' which is a malformed tag, making the HTML body render incorrectly.

findings.title: Lithuanian email anchors changed to invalid href=LT"..." syntax
findings.body: Several anchors were changed from href="{0}" to href=LT"{0}" (missing the opening quote before LT), producing broken attributes in verification and password-reset emails and in the executeActions email. Links in these emails will not work.

findings.title: Persian emailUpdateConfirmationBodyHtml change removes the space before a closing tag only by corrupting the markup
findings.body: The original contained '< p>' malformed tag which was corrected, but this is a content-unrelated fix bundled into a sanitizer PR; unrelated edits make review of the real intent harder.

findings.title: Slovak error-invalid-multivalued-size fix mixes change to plural form key
findings.body: The new value uses {2,choice,...} for the second placeholder and fixes {1} to {2} for the maximum, which is a correct fix, but the trailing newline removal and reordering in the same file was not needed for the sanitizer change; the bundle also keeps impersonateTitleHtml with a stray closing removed, changing markup unrelated to the PR.

findings.title: Czech error-invalid-multivalued-size message uses choice format with unexpected plural rules
findings.body: The added choice pattern uses 1<hodnoty|4<hodnot which is a Czech plural rule that may not match Czech grammar for the value 2-4 (should be 'hodnoty'), so counts 2-4 render with the wrong form.

findings.title: Multivalued size message now uses choice format that the admin UI does not parse with the same placeholder
findings.body: The message changed from value(s) to a choice format but the admin UI in js/apps uses {{0}} style placeholders for this key elsewhere; mixing styles risks the key rendering literally in the admin console.
